tier: Research-only (G7 fails: proxy market, no archived prop prices)
proxy_line_rule: rolling 4-game mean entering week, rounded to 0.5; min 3 prior games
projection_rule: rolling mean x (opponent rolling yards-allowed-to-position / league average)
bet_rule: |projection - proxy line| >= 5 yards; over/under accordingly; priced at -110 for illustration

combo_QB1_WR1.interpretation: A same-game QB-over + WR1-over parlay is worth ~lift x the independent-leg product probability. Books reprice SGPs; without archived SGP prices no edge can be claimed (G7 fails).
